findings.text: `unsetopt local_options nomatch` unsets two options: `local_options` and `nomatch`. It does not scope `nomatch` to the function. Turning off `local_options` also disables zsh's automatic restore on function return. Running `nvm ls` or `nvm alias` in zsh therefore permanently clears `nomatch` in the user's interactive shell, so a later `ls *.nonexistent` passes the literal pattern instead of erroring. The intended call was probably `setopt local_options nonomatch`.
